title: inline input feedback does not auto dismiss
rule: Inline input feedback does not auto-dismiss — text follows the block; stays until the user performs the corresponding interaction.
pass_when: Inline input feedback stays until the corresponding interaction.
overview: Inline input feedback stays until the user performs the related interaction.
apply_when: Showing Ant inline validation or input feedback beside a field.
not_when: Transient toasts that are meant to auto-dismiss by design.
agent_hint: Keep inline input feedback visible until the matching user interaction occurs.
description: Inline input feedback follows the field block and must not auto-dismiss on a timer. It stays until the user performs the corresponding interaction—such as fixing the value or clearing the error. Auto-dismissing inline feedback can vanish before it is read or acted on, leaving the person without guidance. Use lasting inline messages for field feedback; reserve timed dismissal for separate toast patterns that are meant to fade.
do_not_claim: Toast/Message auto-dismiss timings as this inline row.
